summary: OpenAI announced GPT-5.6, a new frontier model described as offering more intelligence per token, better performance per dollar, and more on-demand capability for harder tasks.

mechanisms.reason: The summary claims a new frontier model with more intelligence from every token, but gives no benchmark or capability detail.
mechanisms.quote: Frontier intelligence that scales with your ambition.

mechanisms.reason: The announcement claims improved performance per dollar for the new model, suggesting lower cost per unit of capability.
The phrase about more capability on demand for hard work suggests scalable test-time compute usage, which could increase inference volume.
mechanisms.quote: more capability on demand for your hardest work
